name: next-autonomy
description: Deterministic allowlist for /next-driven devops: dev kubectl, git/tea/board, a board-gated push to main and an on/off prod gate. Never overrides a deny.

progRoot.title: Project root
progRoot.description: Directory that holds your repos. cd, git -C and ls are only approved below it.

devContext.title: Dev kube context
devContext.description: The only kubectl context approved without the prod gate.

remotes.title: Git remotes
remotes.description: Comma-separated remotes git may fetch from and push to.

mainBranch.title: Main branch
mainBranch.description: The branch whose push is gated by board gate merge.

mergeWorktreeRegex.title: Merge worktree path (regex)
mergeWorktreeRegex.description: A push to the main branch is only approved from a directory matching this.

prodGateFile.title: Prod gate file
prodGateFile.description: Prod actions are approved only while its first line is `open`.

devWriteNamespaces.title: Dev namespaces for writes
devWriteNamespaces.description: Comma-separated namespaces on the dev context where kubectl exec/patch/scale/delete/rollout restart are approved. Reads work everywhere.

mainRemote.title: Main remote
mainRemote.description: The remote whose main and task/<id> branches a main push is checked against.
